units.source_text: 母狗蜷曲着脚，被小姐抱在膝盖上。

en.t: The female dog curled up her paws and was held on the young lady's lap.

units.source_text: 当夫人垂下右手，小宠犬就以硬毛小猎狗特有的姿势，

en.t: When the lady lowered her right hand, the little pet dog, in the distinctive posture of a wire-haired terrier,

units.source_text: 一边摇摆着后半身，一边像马那样吧嗒吧嗒地举起前脚调整姿势站起来，

en.t: swayed its hindquarters while lifting its front paws with a clopping motion like a horse, adjusted its stance, and stood up,

units.source_text: 接着纵身跳到夫人的膝盖上落座，然后开始舔阴茎的主体组织。

en.t: then sprang onto the lady's lap, settled there, and began licking the main tissue of the penis.

units.source_text: 小姐似乎要站起来，她望着狗店老板。

en.t: The young lady seemed about to stand up, and she looked at the dog shop owner.
